Maya (product): Drafting RFC for on-prem edge routing profiles. Link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/onprem-edge-routing-profiles — please eyeball scope and acceptance criteria. Goal: support customer-managed BGP or static tunnels, per-tenant egress control, clear rollback path. What risky edge cases should we call out?

Raj (eng-platform): Skimmed the draft. Main gaps: asymmetric return-paths (causes KV cache invalidation), overlapping customer CIDRs, MTU mismatches. We should not assume symmetric L2 connectivity. Propose adding a section: 'Assumptions & Non-goals' and explicitly call out path symmetry and jumbo frames.

Lina (sre): +1 on runbooks. We need automatic detection for route flaps and an SLO-aware failover. Also question: how will we expose per-tenant egress IP mapping in Console? That needs an API contract for ops teams.

Omar (networks): For BGP peering we need templates for ASNs, MD5 auth, and recommended timers. Consider optional BFD for sub-second failure detection between customer router and our edge. Also call out behavior when customer advertises more-specifics — do we accept, filter, or prefer?

Maya (product): Proposed acceptance criteria (first pass): 1) Support both BGP and static tunnel onboarding; 2) Onboarding runbook with command snippets and validation checklist; 3) E2E integration tests covering failover and reconvergence; 4) Console shows per-tenant egress IP and peering health. Anything missing?

Raj (eng-platform): Add technical acceptance items: a) test harness that injects asymmetric return routing and verifies KV cache coherency; b) canary rollout plan: 1% of tenants with latency & error monitors; c) clear fallback policy to hosted runtime if network path becomes unhealthy. Also acceptance metric: <0.5% token/response error regression during rollout.

Lina (sre): Edge cases to document: customers using /31 or /32 subnets (NAT implications), overlapping private ranges with our control plane, and cases where route propagation limits on customer side block routes. Add validation warnings in onboarding.

Omar (networks): Operational note: MTU mismatches cause occasional truncation in grpc streams; include guidance to set 1500 or negotiate PMTU. Also clarify whether we terminate TLS at customer edge or at our routers — that changes failure modes.

Maya (product): Good points. Quick product decision to make: require IPv6 at GA? Customers ask for IPv6 but it multiplies test matrix. Thoughts?

Omar (networks): Defer IPv6 to GA+1. Launch with IPv4 only to reduce initial surface area; ship IPv6 after integration tests and console bits.

Raj (eng-platform): Agreed. Also ensure rolling restarts drain KV caches gracefully — add acceptance: no >0.5% token error increase and cache warmup within X seconds.

Maya (product): Action items: Raj/Omar/Lina add concrete test cases + runbook snippets into the RFC by EOD Friday. I'll update acceptance criteria and the rollout checklist. I'll also schedule a 30m sync.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "onprem-edge-routing-profiles review" Thu 11:00 — invites sent.

Maya (product): Thanks all. I'll update this thread with links to the acceptance checklist and runbook when ready. :thumbsup:
